what: Hovering one cell wraps all cells of the same group (data-key) line by line in a design-tool selection frame — a 1px accent border with 7px handles (background-color cells) on the four corners, and the top of the frame reaches above the group label. The frame turns on instantly with no transition, the label turns the accent color in .2s, and videos in the group pause. Gaps between cells inside the frame are not released, and pressing a gap goes to the first cell link of that group

options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Cell to pick (can be a link) — the same group shares the same data-key
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (If present) group label inside a cell — the frame extends up past it and it takes the accent color when selected
options.--fx-select: Frame, handle and chosen label color (via style), default --kf-accent
options.fx:select: Event the plate emits on each pick — detail is data-key (null when released)

use: project a………
note: The panel (attached element) becomes position: relative and the frame is drawn inside it. Mouse devices only — on touch the cell is just a link. Re-measures when the window size changes.

from.where: index.html .gf-works (work cells flowing in 6 columns — original main.js drawSelection: cells with the same slug are grouped per row (top rounded), .selection 1px #0d99ff + four 7px white corner boxes, top extends up past .label, when is-hovering the name tag turns #0d99ff, grouped videos pause, clicking a gap goes to that work’s page)
